Based on combined information from multiple sources, the events of {{Film|IV}} can be determined to span seven [[Standard day/Legends|days]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] continuity:
*''A New Hope'' establishes that '''two nights''' pass between the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator''{{'s}}]] [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] of [[Prince/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen]] and [[Beru Whitesun Lars/Legends|Beru Lars]]
*'''Day 3''' ends with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] spending the night in the Tatooine [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] following the Lars murders, according to ''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''
*'''Day 4''', which begins with Skywalker and Kenobi traveling to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] and meeting [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], according to "[[Star Wars (1977) 53|The Last Gift From Alderaan!]]", ends with the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|Destruction of Alderaan]] at night. 
*'''Day 5''', according to ''The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi'', encompasses the [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue of Princess Leia]] aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] as well as the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|group's]] arrival on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], according to the [[Star Wars (radio)|''Star Wars'' radio drama]], and ends with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] going to [[Sleep/Legends|sleep]] while preparing for the following day's assault on the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], according to ''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''
*'''Day 6''' begins with Dodonna waking and discovering the [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] weakness in the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]], according to ''The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook'', and ends with the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], according to ''A New Hope''
*'''Day 7''' sees the [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|Royal Award Ceremony]], according to {{StarshipsVehiclesCite|12|In A Galaxy Far, Far Away}}, thus concluding the film
Given that ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' establishes that the events of ''A New Hope'' begin on [[Great ReSynchronization|35:3:3]], the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]] therefore takes place on 35:3:8.
